launch.name: Aurelia
launch.description: A prosperous land of kingdoms, forests, ancient ruins, and forgotten secrets.
launch.modalBody: A prosperous land of kingdoms, forests, ancient ruins, and forgotten secrets. Recommended for characters level 1–30.

launch.name: Vethmoor
launch.description: A harsh continent shaped by war, corruption, and ancient conflicts.
launch.modalBody: A harsh continent shaped by war, corruption, and ancient conflicts. Dangers here scale sharply — recommended for level 30–60 adventurers.

expansionTerritories.name: Sylvaneth
expansionTerritories.modalBody: A mystical forest expansion built around ancient nature magic and the secrets kept by its oldest trees. Coming in a future update.

expansionTerritories.name: Kharzul Wastes
expansionTerritories.shortDescription: A dangerous desert and forgotten civilization.
expansionTerritories.modalBody: A dangerous desert region hiding a forgotten civilization beneath its dunes. Coming in a future update.

expansionTerritories.name: Nightreach
expansionTerritories.modalBody: A dark endgame region shrouded in corruption from the Sundering. Reserved for Elysium's most seasoned heroes. Coming in a future update.
